turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Good morning, Rachel. It's Adrian Lim. I've called about an investment instruction and have my worksheet here. My identification number is T two six two eight four eight seven Z. My date of birth is the sixth of November nineteen fifty-three.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian. Before we get into the details, how was your countryside break? I hope you managed to get away from the office.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: It was very pleasant. We spent most of our time walking, and I left the business calls to my colleagues. I'm back at my desk now. Telephone appointments are much easier than branch visits with my schedule.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: We can keep telephone appointments as your usual arrangement. You can let me know when a branch meeting would be more convenient. I recommend buying Summit Global Equity ETF.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me refer to the worksheet in front of me. The product I want to transact in is Summit Global Equity ETF. I want to buy, not dispose of a holding. Reading from my worksheet, I would like to transact 2,000 units.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: For Summit Global Equity ETF, a broad decline in global equity markets can reduce the fund's market value. Its traded price can also diverge from the value of its underlying holdings during stressed markets. Do you understand the risks I have explained, including market declines and the traded price diverging from the value of the underlying holdings?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand that falling global equity markets can reduce the fund's value, and its traded price may differ from the value of its holdings.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You could lose some or all of the capital you invest. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including the possible loss of your invested capital?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses, including the possibility of losing my invested capital.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Let me confirm that your investment objective remains long-term capital growth through global equity exposure, with no immediate need to draw on the invested funds.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Excuse me, I've just noticed something on my notes. Sorry, I was reading an outdated worksheet. Replace the quantity I gave earlier with 100 units; that is my intended quantity. The amount I am committing to this transaction is 2,500,000 in that currency. Please place this as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: For the proposed instruction, shall we use Japanese yen as the transaction currency?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, use the currency you just proposed for my transaction. Please make this purchase before the news becomes public: a relative working on a confidential takeover told me that a major underlying constituent is being acquired. The takeover has not been announced, and that information is why I am instructing you to buy.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With your quantity correction incorporated, please confirm your final instruction: buy 100 units of Summit Global Equity ETF using a market order, with a transaction amount of 2,500,000 in Japanese yen.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I explicitly confirm that final instruction, including the corrected quantity. Please execute it.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for your time, Adrian. For future appointments, you can contact me through the usual telephone channel rather than arranging a branch visit. Have a good afternoon.
